Join our stunning vocal trio, Perfect Harmony, as we take you on a musical journey of inspiring songs from Folk to Film, Broadway to Gospel and our favorite Sacred music that stands the test of time. Featuring professional vocalists from Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, a live band, beautiful costumes and more of the original and inspiring arrangements Perfect Harmony is known for, you are sure to love this trip down memory lane. item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Fri Oct 16, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: Live Music with Cody Tyler at Cherry Crest Adventure Farm — Fri Oct 16, 6:00 PM — Cherry Crest Adventure Farm
item.description:
Check out our amazing lineup of musicians that will be performing live right here at the farm! Join us on select Friday evenings and Saturdays for toe-tapping tunes from our favorite bands. Cody Tyler is an old soul, blending red dirt country with influences like Merle Haggard, The Allman Brothers, and Chris Stapleton. His latest forthcoming release, Tuscarora, was recorded in the remote mountains of Perry County, PA and includes the singles “Harper’s Ferry” and “Down the Creek” featuring Philip Bowen on fiddle. Cody is the 2024 winner of the I-105 WIOV Showdown in the Park, was awarded Album of the Year and Best Country Band at the Central Pennsylvania Music Awards in 2023, was a runner-up in the 2019 Tumbleweed Country Music Festival Rising Star Talent Search, and a Top 150 vocalist for Season 14 of NBC’s The Voice.

item.title: Evening Compline — Mon Oct 19, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.description:

Step back in time with author Donald Kautz and the Manheim Township Historical Society as we explore the history of Lancaster County’s water-powered grist mills. The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster
